up: List all approved drugs (max_phase >= 4) whose mechanism of action is an antagonist (action_type = 'ANTAGONIST'). Return distinct rows containing the compound preferred name, compound ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, and target ChEMBL ID. Join molecule_dictionary, target_dictionary, and drug_mechanism tables. Do not apply any row limits or ranking.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = dm.tid WHERE md.max_phase >= 4 AND dm.action_type = 'ANTAGONIST'
